Class HttpStatusGuide

java.lang.Object
ca.refundr.highspring.api.HttpStatusGuide
public final class HttpStatusGuide extends Object
REST API HTTP status and error-code guide for Highspring.

Open this page from the Admin UI (API docs / Javadoc) after publishing with mvn javadoc:aggregate (or mvn verify).

How errors are decided

RequestFilter is the single place that maps exceptions to status codes:

  • Expected client problems → 4xx, not written to api_error_log
  • Unexpected server failures → 500 + full stack in api_error_log + developer email

Status codes returned by this API

Highspring HTTP status codes
CodeWhenLogged to api_error_log?Typical cause
200 Successful GET (and some DELETE JSON bodies) No Catalog list, cart read, admin totals, me
201 Resource created No POST /v1/purchases/, POST /v1/cart/checkout/
204 Success with empty body No DELETE /v1/cart/, DELETE /v1/admin/errors/{id}/, OPTIONS
400 Bad client input No BadRequestException: invalid JSON, empty cart checkout, invalid quantities, missing fields
401 Not signed in / bad session No Missing or invalid Authorization: session:{uuid} header; failed Google code exchange treated as unauthorized in the callback
403 Signed in but not allowed No Customer hitting /v1/admin/...; viewing another user's purchase
404 Unknown URL or missing entity No No matching resource in the tree; unknown product id; missing purchase/error id; Allure/Javadoc file not published yet
405 Wrong HTTP method or Accept No POST to a GET-only resource; client not accepting JSON where required
500 Unexpected server failure Yes (full stack) + email Bugs, DB outages, Google 5xx, GET /v1/admin/boom/ demo

Authorization header

   Authorization: session:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000

Session UUIDs come from POST /v1/auth/google/callback/.
